signal: $288M bond passed 60.74%. $22.8M for security incl. AI weapons detection, license plate detection, and a security operations center.
why_icp: The bond literally names AI weapons detection and a central command center. The superintendent said cameras will be an internal system, not Flock.
suggested_contact_title: Superintendent or Director of Operations / Safety
first_line: Saw the $288M bond passed with $22.8M set aside for security, including AI weapons detection and a new command center.

signal: Measure 34-355, $430M bond, 62.2% yes. Plan includes safety and security ($29.6M).
why_icp: A dedicated $29.6M safety and security line in a large district means a buying cycle for camera and detection upgrades is coming.
suggested_contact_title: Chief Operations Officer or Safety & Security Manager
first_line: Congrats on Measure 34-355. The $29.6M safety and security line is a big chunk to plan out across every building.

signal: $680M school construction bond passed 63.43%. Program includes district-wide upgrades for HVAC and security.
why_icp: One of the largest districts in the country with security named as a district-wide upgrade in the bond program.
suggested_contact_title: Chief Facilities & Operations Officer or Director of Security
first_line: Saw the $680M bond passed with 63.43%, and security is one of the district-wide upgrades in the plan.

signal: $95M bond approved to build two new schools and upgrade district security, incl. secure vestibule entrances.
why_icp: Security is in the headline purpose of the bond. New buildings plus retrofits means camera coverage decisions are coming.
suggested_contact_title: Superintendent or Director of Buildings & Grounds
first_line: Saw voters approved the $95M bond, with upgraded district security as one of the two headline goals.

signal: Capital projects levy renewal passed 61.6%, about $1.7M a year for school safety and security systems, classroom tech, and more.
why_icp: Recurring annual money earmarked for safety and security systems fits a subscription camera-AI product better than one-time bond cash.
suggested_contact_title: Superintendent or Director of Finance & Operations
first_line: Saw the levy renewal passed with 61.6%, about $1.7M a year with safety and security systems named first.

signal: Capital project levy approved (63% yes), about $4.6M for taxes payable in 2027, funds safety and security improvements and cybersecurity.
why_icp: Annual levy money with safety and security listed first; a 10-year authorization gives room for a multi-year contract.
suggested_contact_title: Director of Operations or Safety Coordinator
first_line: Saw the capital project levy passed with 63%, with safety and security listed first for the roughly $4.6M a year.

signal: $1.5B bond approved 68% to 31%. Uses include new schools and improving safety, split into four phases over 15 years.
why_icp: Very large program with safety as a stated use; four phases means new buildings will spec security systems over years.
suggested_contact_title: Executive Director of Operations or Director of Safety
first_line: Saw the $1.5B bond passed 68% to 31%, with improving safety listed among the uses.

signal: $165M bond for renovations, safety improvements, technology, athletics, and additions passed 68% to 32%.
why_icp: Mid-size district with safety improvements named in the ask. Good test of a smaller-district motion.
suggested_contact_title: Assistant Superintendent for Business or Facilities Director
first_line: Saw the $165M bond passed, with safety improvements named right next to renovations and technology.

signal: Measure 03-639, $245M bond, 63% yes in partial returns. Covers HVAC, boilers, windows, and safety and accessibility upgrades.
why_icp: Safety is named but next to accessibility, so it may be doors and elevators, not cameras. Lower score on purpose.
suggested_contact_title: Director of Capital Projects or Safety & Security
first_line: Congrats on Measure 03-639. Curious how much of the $245M safety and accessibility work touches cameras.
